projects.title: Parametric rocket design
projects.summary: Using MATLAB programming to turn rocket curvature equations into CAD-ready geometry for a hybrid student rocket’s nose cone and avionics bay.
contributions: Programmed curvature equations in MATLAB using OpenRocket configuration data to generate the rocket’s aerodynamic geometry.
Generated spline-based point inputs in MATLAB and transferred them into CATIA for parametric surface modelling.
Integrated the avionics bay geometry with aerodynamic and structural requirements.
projects.outcome: A connected workflow from rocket configuration data to equations, surface geometry, and component integration.

projects.coverCaption: Illustrative cover · project photography and CAD renders to follow

sections.title: From MATLAB code to CAD geometry
sections.body:
I used MATLAB to connect the mathematical definition of the rocket’s aerodynamic shape with the geometry needed in CATIA. Starting with OpenRocket data, I implemented curvature equations and generated spline-based point inputs for parametric surface modelling.

This is how I like to use programming in engineering: turn a complicated task into a repeatable workflow, then carry the result into design and manufacturing decisions.

projects.title: Beetleweight combat robot
projects.summary: Developing a compact combat robot around a tightly constrained mass budget, balancing impact resistance, packaging, and service access.
contributions: Lead CAD development of the frame, drivetrain, and weapon subsystem.
Model CF-PETG components with steel reinforcement to balance stiffness and weight.
Coordinate electronics placement, wiring protection, and access for maintenance.
projects.outcome: Iterating the mechanical layout around mass, manufacturability, and subsystem integration within beetleweight constraints.

projects.title: Autonomous UAV structures
projects.summary: Contributing to autonomous UAV structures through mechanical design and engineering simulation, using MATLAB/Simulink alongside SolidWorks and ANSYS.
contributions: Design and analyse structural components for frame stiffness and aerodynamic efficiency.
Contribute to FEA and CFD work using SolidWorks, ANSYS, and MATLAB/Simulink.
Coordinate mechanical design with electronics, controls, and AI navigation teams.

projects.title: Asteroid impact visualisation
projects.summary: Building a full-stack visualisation platform that connects asteroid data with geography and demographics to communicate impact scenarios.
contributions: Built a Node.js / Express server and an HTML, CSS, and JavaScript front end.
Integrated NASA NEO data, Esri ArcGIS, and Open-Meteo APIs.
Modelled crater scaling, shockwave radius, and energy propagation using open scientific datasets.
projects.outcome: NASA Space Apps 2025 — Best Storytelling, Second Runner-Up, for scientific communication and system design.
